content.value_statement: Custom authentication extensions are hard to wire into Entra user flows. This skill gives focused .NET patterns for token claims, attribute handling, and OTP events.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to add custom claims during OnTokenIssuanceStart events.
Explains attribute collection start and submit event handling.
Provides patterns for custom OTP delivery responses.
Lists key Authentication Events SDK request, response, and action types.
Summarizes Entra configuration steps for custom authentication extensions.
Includes error handling guidance for authentication event functions.
limitations: Does not deploy Azure infrastructure or create Entra app registrations.
Uses illustrative examples that require production validation and secrets management.
Does not replace Microsoft documentation for current service limits.
Does not provide complete tests for every authentication event path.

use_cases.title: Add Claims for Identity Developers
use_cases.description: Build a token issuance function that adds controlled claims from trusted profile data.

use_cases.title: Customize Sign-Up for Platform Teams
use_cases.description: Handle attribute collection events to prefill values, validate input, or block invalid submissions.

use_cases.title: Prototype OTP Delivery for Security Teams
use_cases.description: Create a custom OTP send handler before connecting an approved SMS or email provider.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Token Event
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for adding static custom claims.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft a .NET Azure Function for OnTokenIssuanceStart. Add two safe sample claims and explain required imports.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Attribute Submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design an OnAttributeCollectionSubmit handler. Validate email and display name, then return user-friendly validation responses.

prompt_templates.title: Plan External Claim Lookup
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced token enrichment with service data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline a secure external profile lookup for token enrichment. Include caching, timeouts, and claim allow-listing.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Authentication Extension
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my Entra authentication event function. Check error handling, logging, claim safety, and deployment configuration.

output_examples.input: Create a token enrichment function for department and cost center claims.
output_examples.output: A concise Azure Functions plan with required SDK types, claim names, validation notes, and deployment reminders.

output_examples.input: Review my attribute collection logic for sign-up blocking.
output: Flags missing input validation and unclear user messages.
Recommends allow-listed domains, correlation logging, and tested fallback behavior.
Suggests cases for local testing before linking the user flow.

output_examples.input: Design a custom OTP send handler for a third-party provider.
output_examples.output: A workflow covering request fields, provider boundaries, success and failure actions, and safe logging practices.

best_practices: Validate all request data before creating claims or modifying attributes.
Use managed identity and approved secret storage for downstream services.
Keep event handlers fast, observable, and safe when dependencies fail.
anti_patterns: Do not add authorization claims from untrusted or unchecked data sources.
Do not log OTP values, full tokens, or unnecessary personal data.
Do not throw unhandled exceptions from authentication event handlers.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps build .NET Azure Functions for Microsoft Entra custom authentication events.

faq.question: Which events are covered?
faq.answer: It covers token issuance, attribute collection start, attribute collection submit, and OTP send events.

faq.question: Can it deploy the Azure Function for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance, but deployment and Entra configuration remain your responsibility.

faq.question: Is external claim lookup supported?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance includes an example pattern, but production code needs allow-listing, timeouts, and monitoring.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is marked compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I review before production use?
faq.answer: Review logging, claim sources, error handling, managed identity use, and Entra custom extension configuration.
